in_sanskrit.name: भारिका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Bharika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'bhari', which means 'bearing a heavy load' or 'strong'. This name is often given to girls who are believed to have the strength and resilience to carry the weight of their responsibilities and obligations.

in_marathi.name: Bharika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Bringer of prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bharika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bharika is a Sanskrit name derived from the root 'bhar' which means to bear or carry.
